reviews.title: 7000x Corsair pc case
reviews.comment: This case is well made and very spacious. This made every component easily accessible while building my computer! Due to the size, it enables you to use ample amount of fans. All around great product. Very well packaged! Thank you to Adrian for help with questions and tracking my order.
reviews.author: Jimmy

reviews.title: Excellent Case
reviews.comment: Excellent case, worth the money.  I modified this case for server use.  It has lots of options that you can fit your needs.  The only drawback for my project is that I need to drill the correct holes to fit my server motherboard.  It is a 12 X 13" motherboard, therefore most of the predrill holes won't fit.
